title: Motec Versus Remotion Total Wrist Arthroplasty - A Prospective Study
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the difference in the results between Motec and Remotion wrist arthroplasty in the treatment of non-rheumatoid wrist arthritis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with painful non-rheumatoid wrist arthritis (posttraumatic arthritis and late stage Kienboeck's disease)
* Age 18-70 years
* ASA class 1-3
